POLICY DOCUMENTS AND CONSTRUCTION

Entire Contract. The Policy Schedule, the Policy Wording, the proposal form and any endorsement shall be read together and form part of this Policy.

Order of Precedence. In case of any conflict, an endorsement shall prevail over the Policy Schedule, and the Policy Schedule shall prevail over the Policy Wording.

Customer Information Sheet. A Customer Information Sheet is enclosed with this Policy. The Customer Information Sheet is a summary only and, in case of dispute, the Policy Wording shall prevail.

Endorsements issued under this Policy: Nil Endorsement.
